skills.name: Energy Transformation
skills.description:
<font color='#404495'>(Hold)</font>: Kimmy continuously shoots Chemical Bolts in the target direction, each bolt consuming 4 energy and dealing 20<font color='#D58E1F'>( +22% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+24% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to the enemy hit. Chemical Bolts that fail to hit an enemy will explode at the end of their paths, dealing the same amount of damage to nearby enemies.
The Chemical Bolts can Crit.
skills.tips: Use 1st skill to attack enemies at a long distance. When enemies are around you, attack as many enemies as possible.

skills.name: Chemical Refinement
skills.description:
Kimmy shoots out enhanced Chemical Spray and recoils in the opposite direction. Enemies that come into contact with the Spray left on the path will take 14<font color='#D58E1F'>( +30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> every 0.5s and be slowed by 40% for 4s.
Kimmy also restores 30 energy upon casting this skill.
skills.tips: When chased after by enemies, use 2nd skill to slow them down.

skills.name: Maximum Charge
skills.description: After a period of charging, Kimmy launches a Luminous Chemical Attack in a designated direction. The projectile will explode upon hitting an enemy or reaching the maximum range, dealing 130<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+115% Total Magic Power)</font>-238<font color='#D58E1F'>( +185% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+211% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to the primary target (scales with charging time) and 83% damage to nearby enemies.
skills.tips: 3rd skill is of long range. When enemies intend to attack you, you can target them in advance; when enemies try to run away, use it to reap them.

skills.name: Chemist's Instinct
skills.description:
Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her Spray Gun, but cannot lock onto a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun attack restores 5 energy on hit and deals <font color='#D58E1F'>( +22% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#27C0C7'>(+24% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> per bullet (increases by 1% for every hero level). 
Kimmy can move while shooting but cannot gain extra Attack Speed. Instead, every 10% Attack Speed she receives will be converted into 5 Movement Speed. Kimmy restores 15 energy each time she kills an enemy.
skills.tips: Kimmy is still in movement while using skills. Keep the distance from enemies and attack them at the same time.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2s (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 1s cooldown.

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.des: Unique Passive - Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4s). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 3s.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.des: Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).

items.name: Blood Wings
items.des: Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.

builds.tips: Kimmy's 1st skill Energy Transformation deals the most part of Damage. Bloodlust Axe provides high Spell Vamp effect; the slowing down effect of Corrosion Scythe enhances hit rate of skills. Arcane Boots boost magic penetration and increase Damage: Kimmy's skills are more likely to trigger Passive of Hunter Strike, and the higher level of movement makes it easier for her to chase or run away from enemies. Blade of Despair can increase Damage to the most. The last equipment depends on conditions: one more Blade of Despair or Dreadnaught Armor are all good chioce.
